evidence.note: sceneCreated is written as !sceneExists in the same return; the CreateScene branch runs only when sceneExists is false, so equal pairs are never produced.
if (!sceneExists) creates the scene; readers never handle combined-true or a separate both-false path beyond the inverted result field.

notes: Scene presence is one bit (existed|created) flattened into a local and its negation on EnsureQaSceneResult.

disqualifier.note: inputCreated is the GetInputSettings miss/create receipt; inputAttached is a later GetSceneItemList membership check on the existing-input branch. Combined-true is uncomputed rather than a masked union: attachment and create-receipt are independent OBS lookups, and EnsureQaSceneResult already stores inputCreated beside sceneCreated as free combinations.

Domain twin of the already-recorded OpenclawGatewayHealthWire ok/plugins pair. projectGatewayHealth copies wire.ok independently and maps missing plugins to error-count 0 and empty loaded; ok does not restate plugin presence.

requireMention is a required per-group behavior toggle; groupPolicy is an independent optional override. The renderer always emits requireMention and only spreads groupPolicy when Some; mention-required with no override is a documented constructor.

OpenAI structured-output json_schema wire fields. schema is required; optional strict is the provider enforcement knob copied from OpenAiCompatLanguageModelConfig.strictJsonSchema and does not restate schema presence.
OpenAI function-tool wire fields. parameters is the required JSON Schema object; optional strict is an independent provider enforcement knob and does not restate parameters presence.
